families.prescribed_model: Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross
While the soldiers were guarding Thy tomb
Beholding the beauty of thy virginity
Fulfilling the dispensation for our sake
When the stone had been sealed
What shall we call you, O holy ones
With the disciples let us come together
Having laid aside all earthly hope
Let us go up with the disciples

Then the Refrain: "We went through fire and water"; and we sing the Idiomelon Sticheron of the Martyrs: "Trophy-bearers of Christ"; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion. Great Doxology. Troparion of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion. Litanies, and the Dismissal, and the usual procession into the narthex, and the First Hour.
